name: Radiance Field-Informed Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that uses a trained neural radiance field (NeRF) to initialize and supervise a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation, improving robustness to lighting variations and geometry artifacts.
summary: Radiance Field-Informed Gaussian Splatting uses a NeRF to initialize and supervise 3D Gaussians, improving robustness to lighting and enabling training from arbitrary camera lens types.
